answer: A workable design: weight rewards by the number of distinct jurisdictions that observed the work. Near-duplicate embeddings collapse the farm into one cluster. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, the bond burns and standing resets to zero. The fable of work and the saffron of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a nebula to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
